title: Vissed FOV control
description: Flexible change and disabling of hand shaking, as well as changing the FOV behavior
body:
🎮 Vissed FOV Control — Ultimate Camera & Visual Control Mod

The ultimate client-side mod for complete control over your camera, FOV, and visual effects. Perfect for PvP players, content creators, and anyone looking to eliminate unwanted screen shaking and fine-tune their visual experience.



![wert](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a826c694ea013a2a5cea03d5a9eab6648795f36.png) ### open menu - right shift 🎥 About Vissed FOV Control Vissed FOV Control is a lightweight Fabric mod that gives you complete control over your camera and visual experience in Minecraft. Unlike simple mods that just disable one or two effects, Vissed FOV Control provides a comprehensive interface to tweak everything from FOV multipliers to camera smoothness. Whether you're a competitive PvP player who needs consistent FOV, a content creator who hates screen shake, or just someone who wants a smoother visual experience, Vissed FOV Control has you covered. ✨ Feature Showcase 🎯 Camera & FOV Control Feature Description FOV Multiplier Independent multipliers for different states (normal, sprinting, flying, etc.) Camera Tilt Disable annoying camera tilting when strafing or landing Swimming FOV Control FOV changes while swimming Smooth Transitions Configure how smoothly FOV changes apply Speed-Based FOV Adjust how much movement speed affects FOV 🚫 Visual Disables Feature Description No Camera Shake Completely remove all camera shaking effects No Portal Shake Disable the shaking effect when going through portals No Nausea Effect Remove the distortion from nausea/potion effects No Bobbing Disable hand bobbing while walking/running ⚙️ Real-Time Configuration Feature Description In-Game Menu Beautiful, intuitive interface to adjust all settings Instant Apply Changes take effect immediately — no restart needed Config File Manual configuration via JSON file for power users Presets Save and load different configurations 📥 Installation Guide Step Action 1️⃣ Install Fabric — Download and install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.11 2️⃣ Download — Get the latest .jar from Modrinth 3️⃣ Place — Put the JAR into your mods/ folder 4️⃣ Launch — Start Minecraft and enjoy! 5️⃣ Configure — Press your configured keybind to open the settings menu 🎮 Settings Overview Based on the in-game configuration menu: 🧪 Main Toggles Setting Options Бер (Take) ✕ / ✓ Злитры (Sprint) ✕ / ✓ Плавание (Swimming) ✕ / ✓ Предметы (Items) ✕ / ✓ 📊 FOV Multipliers 🎚️ Additional Controls Setting Description Скорость FOV speed influence factor Трасса камеры Camera trail effect toggle 🎨 Why Choose Vissed FOV Control? Lightweight — Minimal performance impact, written with Fabric best practices Active Development — Regular updates and community feedback
